$comment: Sponsored banners shown inside the place, community and people cards. Copy $example into ads to run one. Targets: lgas (ids from src/data/lgas.json, e.g. kogi-dekina), states (names as shown on the cards, e.g. Kogi), groups (ids from data/groups, e.g. igala). An ad with no targets runs everywhere. The most specific match wins: lga, then group, then state, then site-wide; ties rotate by card. start/end are optional YYYY-MM-DD (end inclusive). image is optional (a path under public/ or a full URL). When nothing matches, an 'Advertise here' slot links to contact.
